title: Machine-learning biomarkers read salicylic and jasmonic acid states in field Arabidopsis
summary: Systematically varying salicylic acid (SA) and jasmonic acid (JA) concentrations in Arabidopsis thaliana revealed 43 combination-specific transcriptional signatures beyond SA-JA antagonism. Machine-learning biomarkers built on these data measure SA and JA response states from gene expression and were validated according to the abstract. Applied to field-grown plants, the states were associated with herbivore abundance and co-occurrence on individual plants. The herbivory association is correlational.
ai_technology: Machine-learning transcriptomic biomarkers trained on 43 SA/JA combination signatures
organization: Keio University; Keio University Shonan Fujisawa; Institute for Advanced Biosciences, Keio University
